other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered construction labourer (male) or a registered female construction labourer
The applicant must have completed at least 365 days (1 year) of board membership after registration
Application must be submitted within one year of the marriage or 15 days before the date of a mass marriage
Aadhaar authentication of the daughter is mandatory
Benefit is limited to a maximum of two children per beneficiary
The daughter must be at least 18 years old and the bridegroom at least 21 years old
Group marriage benefits apply only when a minimum of 11 couples are married together
Remarriage benefits are available only for legally divorced or widowed female workers, with required court or death certificates
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance of Rs.55,000 for a daughter's marriage (Rs.61,000 for inter‑caste marriage, Rs.65,000 for group marriage) together with dress allowance and organizer fees.
documents_required: Attested copy of court divorce order (if applicable)
Copy of death certificate of the husband (if applicable)
